description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'AmqpErrorException' that wraps an AMQP error for use within the Eclipse Hono project. It provides constructors to create exceptions based on an AMQP error symbol or string, and methods to retrieve the error details and convert them into an AMQP ErrorCondition.

classes.name: AmqpErrorException
classes.description: A final class extending RuntimeException that encapsulates an AMQP error symbol, providing methods to access the error and convert it to an ErrorCondition.

methods.name: AmqpErrorException(Symbol, String)
methods.description: Constructor creating an exception for given AMQP Symbol error and description.

methods.name: AmqpErrorException(String, String)
methods.description: Constructor creating an exception for given error string (converted to Symbol) and description.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the AMQP Symbol error associated with this exception.

methods.name: asErrorCondition
methods.description: Converts the encapsulated error into an AMQP ErrorCondition using ProtonHelper.
